meta.description: Automate API Bible tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动通过 MCP 执行 API 相关任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化 API 相关重复任务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate repetitive API tasks

howto.what: Claude 会先搜索 API Bible 工具的最新 schema，然后检查连接状态，最后执行你指定的圣经相关操作（如查询经文、搜索等）。
howto.when: 当你提出与圣经相关的请求时触发，例如查询具体经文、搜索关键词或管理 API Bible 连接。

say.text: 帮我查一下约翰福音3章16节
say.note: Claude 将搜索工具并获取该经文。

say.text: 搜索圣经中关于爱的经文
say.note: Claude 会通过工具搜索相关章节。
Claude 会调用管理连接工具查看状态。

howto.what_en: Claude will first search for the latest schemas of API Bible tools, then check the connection status, and finally execute the Bible-related task you request (e.g., retrieving verses, searching).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you make a request related to the Bible, such as querying a specific verse, searching keywords, or managing the API Bible connection.

say_en.note: Claude will search tools and retrieve the verse.

say_en.text: Search for verses about love in the Bible.
say_en.note: Claude will use tools to search relevant passages.
Claude will call the connection management tool.
